blocking_findings.reason: Current final layer-2 records still fail the previously ticketed toxicity/selectivity repair. The final marks unsupported records as source_verified: 6538 is used as a unitless hemolysis/viability scalar although the source uses ATCC6538 as a strain token and reports hemolytic IC50 6368.1 µM; 25 and 50 mg/kg are labeled selectivity indexes although the supplement says they are mouse body-weight monitoring doses; the real p33 cytotoxic IC50 >38.08 µM (17.6 µg/mL), hemolytic IC50 6368.1 µM, acute toxicity at 100 mg/kg, Fig S2 body-weight monitoring, and Galleria LD50 >512 µg/mL evidence are not represented as faithful final row-level toxicity records. MIC rows also cite xml:p:32 as method support even though susceptibility methods are in xml:p:11.

cautions.summary: No authoritative DBAASP/APD6/DRAMP linked rows are present. Fallback daptomycin rows are correctly unresolved and not ingest-ready, but the paper cannot be used as authoritative database ingest evidence without future linked rows or explicit release policy approval.

The MOESM2 ChemDraw OLE object was exposed as CDX printable labels, but exact chemical graph topology was not rendered locally. This is acceptable only if no final claim depends on exact YZ462 structure/topology from that object.

The latest packet, semantic, publication, and strict acceptance gates report pass/zero hard findings, but independent source review finds current final layer-2 toxicity scalar errors. Green gates are therefore not sufficient terminal evidence for this paper.
